::: {#exm-strict-subset}
#### Strict subsets

- $\set{2, 4, 6} \subsetneq \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
  because $\set{2, 4, 6} \subseteq \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$ (@exm-subset),
  and $1$ is in the second set but not the first.
- $\Nat \subsetneq \mathbb{Z}$,
  because every natural number is an integer,
  and $-1$ is an integer that is not a natural number.
- $\mathbb{Z} \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$, because every integer is an integer,
  but $\mathbb{Z}$ is not a strict subset of itself.

:::
